'''Enzo Ferroni''' (25 March 1921 – 9 April 2007) was an Italian chemist, and [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[University of Florence]] from 1976 to 1979.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Dei |first=Luigi |date=21 September 2023 |title=Enzo Ferroni (1921-2007): the History of an Eclectic Chemist |journal=Substantia |publisher=[[Firenze University Press]] |volume=7 |issue=2 |pages=83–100 |doi=10.36253/Substantia-2055 |issn=2532-3997 |doi-access=free}} {{Creative Commons text attribution notice|cc=by4|from this source=yes}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Enzo Ferroni was born in [[Florence]], [[Italy]] on 25 March 1921 and was educated at the [[University of Florence|Royal University of Florence]].{{citation needed|date=July 2025}} Ferroni defended his chemistry master’s thesis (''Recent advances and opinions on chemical kinetics)'' in 1945 under the supervision of Giorgio Piccardi.<ref name=":0" />

Ferroni founded the Italian Centre for Colloids and Surfaces (CSGI) in 1993 and served as its President until his death in 2007.<ref name=":0" />
